entities.name: Collegiate church in Wiślica
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Collegiate church in Wiślica is a Gothic church, erected in 1350 in the southern Polish town of Wiślica, during the reign of King Casimir III of Poland. It was built on foundations of two earlier Romanesque churches, of which remains have been preserved in the crypt.
